title: Keto Gochi Gratin
description: A delicious and light Mexican dish featuring fish sauce in a crispy, cheesy base with a garlicky flavor profile, perfect for a quick keto-friendly dinner.
instructions: Season cod or tilapia fillets with salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Drizzle fish with olive oil and a touch of fish sauce.
Spread sliced almonds evenly on baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Place seasoned fish fillets over the almonds.
Whisk together shredded cheddar cheese, grated parmesan, chopped cilantro, salt, pepper, and fish sauce in a bowl. Pour mixture over fish and almonds.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the top is golden brown and cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.
